item.title: [7] Experimental observation of critical topology
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Shuang Zhang, Jian-Hua Jiang

Authors: Zhi-Kang Lin, Li-Wei Wang, Ze-Lin Kong, et al.

Score 7/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Fundamental topological physics exploring critical gapless states and wavefunctions.; tier capped to C: formal/generic theory watch

Tags: #topological-physics #experiment

Abstract: Experimental evidence indicating that critical gapless topological states can be characterized by the entanglement spectrum and wavefunctions is presented, demonstrating persistence of topology at phase boundaries and extension to higher-dimensional systems.

item.title: [9] A chiral superlattice route to spin-split topological antiferromagnetism
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Philip Kim, Su-Yang Xu

Authors: Thao Dinh, Mengke Liu, Jian-Xiang Qiu, et al.

Score 9/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Direct hit on topological antiferromagnetism, Berry curvature, and anomalous Hall in a chiral system.; demoted from A: broad CM, not direct user/project hit

Tags: #material #topological-magnetism #Berry-curvature

Abstract: A chiral superlattice in collinear antiferromagnetic UOTe generates large Berry curvature and spin-polarized currents, enabling anomalous Hall effects and advancing chiral quantum materials for spintronics.

item.title: [6] Spatially deterministic nucleation of 2D semiconductors by etching flux
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Chang-Soo Lee, Kibum Kang

Authors: Jeongwon Park, Jiyun Kim, Sumin Kang, et al.

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: New growth technique for 2D semiconductors relevant to the user's interest in monolayer materials.

Tags: #growth #2Dsemiconductor #materialscience

Abstract: Etching-flux-mediated single-centred nucleation of two-dimensional semiconductors is used to deterministically localize a single nucleation event, expanding semiconductor deposition from controlling where materials grow to controlling where and how crystals can begin to form.

item.title: [6] Observation of critical topological phase transition
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Jiangbin Gong, Baile Zhang

Authors: Zheyu Cheng, Xiuhai Zhang, Xue-Jia Yu, Longwen Zhou, Jiangbin Gong, Baile Zhang

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Demonstration of topological transitions beyond standard paradigms, though implemented in an acoustic metamaterial platform.

Tags: #metamaterial #topology #phasetransition

Abstract: Using an acoustic metamaterial platform, a critical topological phase transition is experimentally demonstrated establishing a hierarchical phase transition organization, in which topology shapes criticality beyond the conventional Landau–Ginzburg paradigm and standard topological phase transitions.
